summary: Hand-wrote seven reader-facing console pages for the lifetime-objective family, replacing machine-generated drafts: rollout-veto-17k, scenario, afterstate-net, score-decomposition, risk-calibration, gpu and common. Each page follows docs/agents/approach-page-template.md, quotes only figures that exist in a retained record (findings 01-05, gpu-01/02/03, design-01, reconciliation-01 and contribution record CT-20260820T100249Z-b1ea4b1a) with its evidence label carried through, and states 'no retained result' where that is the truth, notably for afterstate-net and common. Added a one-sentence summary line to the existing hand-written leaf-reweight page frontmatter without altering its body. One new figure on the scenario page — a start board and a two-outcome comparison showing that a gray disc's number depends on when it is opened — was generated with the repository's TypeScript engine rather than drawn by hand.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
